pool.text: Yakov Lazarevich Semyonov arrived as the first civilian settler
The main Russian naval base on the Pacific Ocean was transferred
The post officially received the status of a city
Minny Gorodok park is a former military base founded in Vladivostok.
The railway station was completed at the street intersection
Vladivostok's first tram line was started along Svetlanskaya Street
The government decided to accelerate the industrialization of the country
The Primorsky Regional Academic Drama Theater opened in Vladivostok as the oldest state theater.
A location in Vladivostok was converted into a park before closing later.
The House of Artists was built with exhibition halls
The Primorsky State Art Gallery was separated into a separate institution
Gerald Ford paid an official visit to meet with Leonid Brezhnev
Minny Gorodok in Vladivostok was converted into a park containing lakes and ponds.
The gallery of contemporary art Artetage was opened
The land of a park in Vladivostok belongs to the Russian Orthodox Church.
Boris Yeltsin signed a decree ending the closed city status
The Arka gallery of contemporary art was opened
The city hosted the VladiROCKstok International Music Festival
The new City Council began operations and deputies started work
A non-commercial private gallery Roytau appeared
